children: Bion's revenue was unchanged at nil and its net loss widened year over year, as higher general and administrative expenses—including $425,000 of non-cash director compensation—more than offset lower consulting, investor-relations and research-and-development costs. Other expense also increased.

: Bion is prioritizing bolt-on ammonia-control solutions for existing or planned biogas facilities.
: The company reported several non-binding offtake commitments for its AB10 nitrogen fertilizer.
: Bion said its ammonia recovery system optimization is complete, its value proposition proven and the technology ready for final design.
: Bion is in discussions with potential engineering, renewable-energy and fertilizer-distribution partners.
